output.reason: The only evidence, [ev-873cf7661375], is one upgrade-guide line that lists four separate RBAC permission changes: three additions (delete pods, get/patch crds, update nodes) and one removal (create nodes). It does not say which ClusterRole or service account they apply to. It also does not say which environments are exposed (for example, those that manage their own RBAC instead of using the Helm chart). Nor does it say what happens if the operator does nothing, such as failed node updates or pod deletions. Writing typed assertions needs the change split into its individual permission changes, plus evidence for each one, such as the chart RBAC diff, that names the role and the effect.
